title: ~んです (Explanation)
explanation: Used to provide an explanation, state an excuse, or ask for an explanation. It gives sentences a 'Listen, here's the reason' nuance.
structure:
[Short form] + んです
Exception: Noun/な-adj takes なんです

examples.japanese:
どうして遅れたんですか。
バスが来なかったんです。
examples.english:
Why were you late?
(The reason is) the bus didn't come.

examples.japanese: 明日テストがあるんです。
examples.english: It's because I have a test tomorrow.

notes: In written language, 'のです' is often used instead of 'んです'.

title: ~すぎる (Too much)
explanation: Attaches to verb stems and adjective bases to mean 'too much / excessively'. It conjugates like a Ru-verb.

examples.japanese: 昨日、お酒を飲みすぎました。
examples.english: I drank too much alcohol yesterday.

title: ~ほうがいいです (Better to do)
explanation:
Used to give advice (You had better do...). 
Affirmative advice: た-form + ほうがいい
Negative advice: ない-form + ほうがいい
structure:
[Verb た form] + ほうがいいですよ
[Verb ない form] + ほうがいいですよ

examples.japanese: 毎日運動したほうがいいですよ。
examples.english: You had better exercise every day.

examples.japanese: タバコを吸わないほうがいいですよ。

practice.question: Give advice to sleep early. (早く寝る)
practice.answer: 早く寝たほうがいいですよ。

title: ~ので (Given that / Since)
explanation: A more formal and objective version of 'から' (because/since). Usually followed by polite requests or apologies.
structure:
[Short form] + ので
Exception: Noun/な-adj takes なので

examples.japanese: 今日は日曜日なので、銀行は休みです。
examples.english: Since today is Sunday, the bank is closed.

examples.japanese: 宿題がたくさんあったので、寝ませんでした。
examples.english: Given that there was a lot of homework, I didn't sleep.

practice.question: Translate: 'Since it is cold, please close the window.'
practice.answer: 寒いので、窓を閉めてください。

title: ~なくちゃいけません (Must do)
explanation: Meaning 'Must do'. Drop the 'ない' from the negative short form and add 'なくちゃいけません' (casual 'have to'). Formal is 'なければいけません'.
structure: [Verb ~ない stem] + なくちゃいけません

examples.japanese: 明日テストがあるから、勉強しなくちゃいけません。
examples.english: Because I have a test tomorrow, I must study.

practice.question: 薬を（飲む）なくちゃいけません -> 薬を（　）なくちゃいけません。

title: ~でしょう (Probably)
explanation: Used to make a guess or prediction. Follows short forms. Spoken with a rising intonation, it asks for agreement ('Right?').
structure:
[Short form] + でしょう
Exception: Noun/な-adj do not take だ.

examples.japanese: 明日は雨が降るでしょう。
北海道は寒いでしょう。

practice.question: Translate: 'It was probably busy yesterday.'
practice.answer: 昨日は忙しかったでしょう。
